name: Zombie Girl
source:
Likes: Sweets and sleeping
Dislikes: Vegetables

A mysterious zombie who appeared in front of Sam. It's unsure if she has any unfinished business left to do as she doesn't remember anything from when she was alive. All that Sam knows about her is that she loves to eat sweets.

[From [url=https://tsundere-studio.itch.io/my-sweet-zombie]itch.io[/url]]
